source_scope: Official web pages and Bonn Dataverse file metadata only; no payload, challenge labels, or media downloaded or opened.

license.official_dataset_page: CC BY 4.0; official page states commercial use is permitted with attribution
license.payload_terms_and_participant_consent_sc: UNKNOWN pending review of the deposited documentation and source-specific terms

task_and_split.challenge_t1: RGB clips to articulation type and axis estimation
task_and_split.challenge_t2: RGB clips to peak force and mechanical work regression; force is the target, not an inference-time input
task_and_split.challenge_split: 40 interactions from two kitchens; hidden ground truth
task_and_split.independent_group_basis: Official page reports 38 environments; no candidate-specific train/validation/audit group split has been verified

decision: REVIEW_NOT_ADMITTED: the published force challenge predicts sensor targets from video rather than requiring synchronized video and force as joint decision inputs; the challenge has only 40 interactions across two kitchens, no verified independent candidate split, and the full release is about 2967 GiB.
